panels.description: Share of credit-card transactions by debit or credit type.

targets.rawSql: WITH f AS (SELECT trans_type FROM expenses.main.cc_categorized WHERE trans_type IN ('debit','credit') AND $__timeFilter(trans_dt) AND ('${trans_mode:raw}'='NULL' OR trans_mode IN (${trans_mode:sqlstring})) AND ('${category:raw}'='NULL' OR category IN (${category:sqlstring})) AND ('${subcategory:raw}'='NULL' OR subcategory IN (${subcategory:sqlstring})) AND ('${entity:raw}'='NULL' OR normalized_trans_src IN (${entity:sqlstring})) AND trans_amt BETWEEN TRY_CAST(${min_amount} AS DOUBLE) AND TRY_CAST(${max_amount} AS DOUBLE)) SELECT COALESCE(100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE trans_type='debit')/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),0) AS "Purchases", COALESCE(100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE trans_type='credit')/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),0) AS "Payments / credits" FROM f

panels.title: Transaction Mix

panels.description: Purchase spending and payments or credits as a share of matching transaction value.

targets.rawSql: WITH f AS (SELECT trans_type,trans_amt FROM expenses.main.cc_categorized WHERE trans_type IN ('debit','credit') AND $__timeFilter(trans_dt) AND ('${trans_mode:raw}'='NULL' OR trans_mode IN (${trans_mode:sqlstring})) AND ('${category:raw}'='NULL' OR category IN (${category:sqlstring})) AND ('${subcategory:raw}'='NULL' OR subcategory IN (${subcategory:sqlstring})) AND ('${entity:raw}'='NULL' OR normalized_trans_src IN (${entity:sqlstring})) AND trans_amt BETWEEN TRY_CAST(${min_amount} AS DOUBLE) AND TRY_CAST(${max_amount} AS DOUBLE)) SELECT COALESCE(100.0*SUM(trans_amt) FILTER(WHERE trans_type='debit')/NULLIF(SUM(trans_amt),0),0) AS "Purchase spend", COALESCE(100.0*SUM(trans_amt) FILTER(WHERE trans_type='credit')/NULLIF(SUM(trans_amt),0),0) AS "Payments / credits" FROM f

panels.title: Amount Mix

panels.description: Net card outflow as a share of purchase spending. Lower values can reflect repayments and refunds; this is not a bank-account savings rate.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(100.0*(SUM(trans_amt) FILTER(WHERE trans_type='debit')-SUM(trans_amt) FILTER(WHERE trans_type='credit'))/NULLIF(SUM(trans_amt) FILTER(WHERE trans_type='debit'),0),0) AS "Net card outflow" FROM expenses.main.cc_categorized WHERE trans_type IN ('debit','credit') AND $__timeFilter(trans_dt) AND ('${trans_mode:raw}'='NULL' OR trans_mode IN (${trans_mode:sqlstring})) AND ('${category:raw}'='NULL' OR category IN (${category:sqlstring})) AND ('${subcategory:raw}'='NULL' OR subcategory IN (${subcategory:sqlstring})) AND ('${entity:raw}'='NULL' OR normalized_trans_src IN (${entity:sqlstring})) AND trans_amt BETWEEN TRY_CAST(${min_amount} AS DOUBLE) AND TRY_CAST(${max_amount} AS DOUBLE)

panels.title: Net Card Outflow

panels.description: Daily purchase spending split by card issuer.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CAST(trans_dt AS TIMESTAMP) AS time, SUM(trans_amt) FILTER (WHERE trans_mode='cc_axis') AS "Axis", SUM(trans_amt) FILTER (WHERE trans_mode='cc_icici') AS "ICICI" FROM expenses.main.cc_categorized WHERE trans_type='debit' AND trans_mode IN ('cc_axis','cc_icici') AND $__timeFilter(trans_dt) AND ('${trans_mode:raw}'='NULL' OR trans_mode IN (${trans_mode:sqlstring})) AND ('${category:raw}'='NULL' OR category IN (${category:sqlstring})) AND ('${subcategory:raw}'='NULL' OR subcategory IN (${subcategory:sqlstring})) AND ('${entity:raw}'='NULL' OR normalized_trans_src IN (${entity:sqlstring})) AND trans_amt BETWEEN TRY_CAST(${min_amount} AS DOUBLE) AND TRY_CAST(${max_amount} AS DOUBLE) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Daily Spend by Card Issuer

panels.description: Monthly purchase spending split by card issuer.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month',trans_dt) AS TIMESTAMP) AS time, SUM(trans_amt) FILTER (WHERE trans_mode='cc_axis') AS "Axis", SUM(trans_amt) FILTER (WHERE trans_mode='cc_icici') AS "ICICI" FROM expenses.main.cc_categorized WHERE trans_type='debit' AND trans_mode IN ('cc_axis','cc_icici') AND $__timeFilter(trans_dt) AND ('${trans_mode:raw}'='NULL' OR trans_mode IN (${trans_mode:sqlstring})) AND ('${category:raw}'='NULL' OR category IN (${category:sqlstring})) AND ('${subcategory:raw}'='NULL' OR subcategory IN (${subcategory:sqlstring})) AND ('${entity:raw}'='NULL' OR normalized_trans_src IN (${entity:sqlstring})) AND trans_amt BETWEEN TRY_CAST(${min_amount} AS DOUBLE) AND TRY_CAST(${max_amount} AS DOUBLE) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Monthly Spend by Card Issuer

panels.description: Card spending by category and subcategory.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(category,'Uncategorized') AS category, SUM(trans_amt) AS "Purchase spend" FROM expenses.main.cc_categorized WHERE trans_type='debit' AND $__timeFilter(trans_dt) AND ('${trans_mode:raw}'='NULL' OR trans_mode IN (${trans_mode:sqlstring})) AND ('${category:raw}'='NULL' OR category IN (${category:sqlstring})) AND ('${subcategory:raw}'='NULL' OR subcategory IN (${subcategory:sqlstring})) AND ('${entity:raw}'='NULL' OR normalized_trans_src IN (${entity:sqlstring})) AND trans_amt BETWEEN TRY_CAST(${min_amount} AS DOUBLE) AND TRY_CAST(${max_amount} AS DOUBLE) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Purchase Spend by Category

panels.description: Credit-card purchases by issuer / payment mode.

targets.rawSql: SELECT UPPER(REPLACE(trans_mode,'cc_','')) AS issuer, SUM(trans_amt) AS "Purchase spend" FROM expenses.main.cc_categorized WHERE trans_type='debit' AND $__timeFilter(trans_dt) AND ('${trans_mode:raw}'='NULL' OR trans_mode IN (${trans_mode:sqlstring})) AND ('${category:raw}'='NULL' OR category IN (${category:sqlstring})) AND ('${subcategory:raw}'='NULL' OR subcategory IN (${subcategory:sqlstring})) AND ('${entity:raw}'='NULL' OR normalized_trans_src IN (${entity:sqlstring})) AND trans_amt BETWEEN TRY_CAST(${min_amount} AS DOUBLE) AND TRY_CAST(${max_amount} AS DOUBLE) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Spend by Card Issuer

panels.description: Largest card merchants by purchase amount.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(normalized_trans_src),''),'Unmatched') AS merchant, SUM(trans_amt) AS "Purchase spend" FROM expenses.main.cc_categorized WHERE trans_type='debit' AND $__timeFilter(trans_dt) AND ('${trans_mode:raw}'='NULL' OR trans_mode IN (${trans_mode:sqlstring})) AND ('${category:raw}'='NULL' OR category IN (${category:sqlstring})) AND ('${subcategory:raw}'='NULL' OR subcategory IN (${subcategory:sqlstring})) AND ('${entity:raw}'='NULL' OR normalized_trans_src IN (${entity:sqlstring})) AND trans_amt BETWEEN TRY_CAST(${min_amount} AS DOUBLE) AND TRY_CAST(${max_amount} AS DOUBLE) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Top Merchants by Spend

panels.description: Purchase distribution across transaction amount bands.

targets.rawSql: WITH f AS (SELECT trans_amt FROM expenses.main.cc_categorized WHERE trans_type='debit' AND $__timeFilter(trans_dt) AND ('${trans_mode:raw}'='NULL' OR trans_mode IN (${trans_mode:sqlstring})) AND ('${category:raw}'='NULL' OR category IN (${category:sqlstring})) AND ('${subcategory:raw}'='NULL' OR subcategory IN (${subcategory:sqlstring})) AND ('${entity:raw}'='NULL' OR normalized_trans_src IN (${entity:sqlstring})) AND trans_amt BETWEEN TRY_CAST(${min_amount} AS DOUBLE) AND TRY_CAST(${max_amount} AS DOUBLE)) SELECT CASE WHEN trans_amt<500 THEN '₹0–499' WHEN trans_amt<2000 THEN '₹500–1,999' WHEN trans_amt<5000 THEN '₹2,000–4,999' WHEN trans_amt<10000 THEN '₹5,000–9,999' WHEN trans_amt<25000 THEN '₹10,000–24,999' ELSE '₹25,000+' END AS amount_band, COUNT(*) AS transactions FROM f GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY MIN(trans_amt)

panels.title: Purchase Count by Amount Band

panels.description: Latest credit-card transactions matching the selected filters.

targets.rawSql: SELECT trans_dt AS date, UPPER(REPLACE(trans_mode,'cc_','')) AS issuer, normalized_trans_src AS merchant, category, subcategory, trans_type AS transaction_type, trans_amt AS amount, particulars FROM expenses.main.cc_categorized WHERE trans_type IN ('debit','credit') AND $__timeFilter(trans_dt) AND ('${trans_mode:raw}'='NULL' OR trans_mode IN (${trans_mode:sqlstring})) AND ('${category:raw}'='NULL' OR category IN (${category:sqlstring})) AND ('${subcategory:raw}'='NULL' OR subcategory IN (${subcategory:sqlstring})) AND ('${entity:raw}'='NULL' OR normalized_trans_src IN (${entity:sqlstring})) AND trans_amt BETWEEN TRY_CAST(${min_amount} AS DOUBLE) AND TRY_CAST(${max_amount} AS DOUBLE) ORDER BY trans_dt DESC LIMIT 500

panels.title: Recent Credit-Card Transactions

panels.description: Transactions grouped by merchant across at least three different months; a heuristic recurring-spend signal, not a subscription guarantee.

targets.rawSql: SELECT normalized_trans_src AS merchant, COUNT(DISTINCT DATE_TRUNC('month',trans_dt)) AS active_months, COUNT(*) AS purchase_count, ROUND(SUM(trans_amt),2) AS total_spend, ROUND(AVG(trans_amt),2) AS average_transaction, MIN(trans_dt) AS first_seen, MAX(trans_dt) AS last_seen FROM expenses.main.cc_categorized WHERE trans_type='debit' AND normalized_trans_src IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(normalized_trans_src)<>'' AND $__timeFilter(trans_dt) AND ('${trans_mode:raw}'='NULL' OR trans_mode IN (${trans_mode:sqlstring})) AND ('${category:raw}'='NULL' OR category IN (${category:sqlstring})) AND ('${subcategory:raw}'='NULL' OR subcategory IN (${subcategory:sqlstring})) AND ('${entity:raw}'='NULL' OR normalized_trans_src IN (${entity:sqlstring})) AND trans_amt BETWEEN TRY_CAST(${min_amount} AS DOUBLE) AND TRY_CAST(${max_amount} AS DOUBLE) GROUP BY normalized_trans_src HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT DATE_TRUNC('month',trans_dt))>=3 ORDER BY active_months DESC,total_spend DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Recurring Merchant Trends

panels.description: Counts and sums transactions with missing categories or merchant normalization.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_transactions, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE category IS NULL OR TRIM(category)='') AS uncategorized, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE normalized_trans_src IS NULL OR TRIM(normalized_trans_src)='') AS unmatched_sources, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE trans_type='debit') AS purchases, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE trans_type='credit') AS payments_credits, ROUND(SUM(trans_amt) FILTER(WHERE trans_type='debit'),2) AS purchase_amount, ROUND(SUM(trans_amt) FILTER(WHERE trans_type='credit'),2) AS credit_amount FROM expenses.main.cc_categorized WHERE trans_type IN ('debit','credit') AND $__timeFilter(trans_dt) AND ('${trans_mode:raw}'='NULL' OR trans_mode IN (${trans_mode:sqlstring})) AND ('${category:raw}'='NULL' OR category IN (${category:sqlstring})) AND ('${subcategory:raw}'='NULL' OR subcategory IN (${subcategory:sqlstring})) AND ('${entity:raw}'='NULL' OR normalized_trans_src IN (${entity:sqlstring})) AND trans_amt BETWEEN TRY_CAST(${min_amount} AS DOUBLE) AND TRY_CAST(${max_amount} AS DOUBLE)

panels.title: Data Quality & Coverage

panels.description: Purchase totals by month compared with the optional monthly card-spend budget.

targets.rawSql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month',trans_dt) AS month,SUM(trans_amt) AS actual_spend FROM expenses.main.cc_categorized WHERE trans_type='debit' AND $__timeFilter(trans_dt) AND ('${trans_mode:raw}'='NULL' OR trans_mode IN (${trans_mode:sqlstring})) AND ('${category:raw}'='NULL' OR category IN (${category:sqlstring})) AND ('${subcategory:raw}'='NULL' OR subcategory IN (${subcategory:sqlstring})) AND ('${entity:raw}'='NULL' OR normalized_trans_src IN (${entity:sqlstring})) AND trans_amt BETWEEN TRY_CAST(${min_amount} AS DOUBLE) AND TRY_CAST(${max_amount} AS DOUBLE) GROUP BY 1), budget AS (SELECT TRY_CAST(${monthly_budget} AS DOUBLE) AS amount) SELECT STRFTIME(month,'%Y-%m') AS month,ROUND(actual_spend,2) AS actual_spend,CASE WHEN amount>0 THEN ROUND(amount,2) END AS monthly_budget,CASE WHEN amount>0 THEN ROUND(actual_spend-amount,2) END AS variance,CASE WHEN amount>0 THEN ROUND(100.0*(actual_spend-amount)/NULLIF(amount,0),1) END AS variance_percent FROM monthly CROSS JOIN budget ORDER BY month DESC

panels.title: Monthly Card Budget vs Actual

panels.description: Purchase totals for a selected calendar year compared with the previous year.

targets.rawSql: WITH sel AS (SELECT TRY_CAST(${yoy_year:raw} AS INTEGER) AS yr), f AS (SELECT trans_dt,trans_amt FROM expenses.main.cc_categorized CROSS JOIN sel WHERE trans_type='debit' AND YEAR(trans_dt) IN (sel.yr,sel.yr-1) AND ('${trans_mode:raw}'='NULL' OR trans_mode IN (${trans_mode:sqlstring})) AND ('${category:raw}'='NULL' OR category IN (${category:sqlstring})) AND ('${subcategory:raw}'='NULL' OR subcategory IN (${subcategory:sqlstring})) AND ('${entity:raw}'='NULL' OR normalized_trans_src IN (${entity:sqlstring})) AND trans_amt BETWEEN TRY_CAST(${min_amount} AS DOUBLE) AND TRY_CAST(${max_amount} AS DOUBLE)) SELECT STRFTIME(MAKE_DATE(2000,MONTH(trans_dt),1),'%b') AS month,SUM(trans_amt) FILTER(WHERE YEAR(trans_dt)=sel.yr) AS "Selected year",SUM(trans_amt) FILTER(WHERE YEAR(trans_dt)=sel.yr-1) AS "Prior year" FROM f CROSS JOIN sel GROUP BY MONTH(trans_dt) ORDER BY MONTH(trans_dt)
